historical_failure_reason: The original traceback exposes only data = path.read_bytes() followed by f.read() PermissionError without filename or loop-local path. The scanner did not persist each attempted file or stat before reading. An exact historical pathname is therefore not proven.

candidate.evidence: Present in the preserved case; post-exit scan records 1 byte. Current independent lstat/read confirms the same 1-byte regular non-reparse file, attributes 32, mtime_ns 1794909996484088000, SHA256 below.
candidate.producer_behavior: Opens writer.lock O_CREAT|O_RDWR. On Windows, writes one zero byte only if initially empty, seeks to zero and locks one byte with msvcrt.LK_NBLCK. close() closes the owner handle; it does not unlink the file. It does not truncate a preexisting nonempty file, so suffix alone never proves length.
candidate.interpretation: Strong candidate for a read-time Windows byte-lock denial, but current size and producer are not an exact historical path proof. No categorical attribution of the previous failure.

proposed_scanner_change.scope: External test helper only, not product
proposed_scanner_change.before_each_read: Persist relative path, lstat size/type/attributes and attempted-read sequence before reading; reject symlinks/reparse points.
proposed_scanner_change.permission_error_rule: Only for the exact owned canonical journal writer.lock path, with fixture-owned live journal producer, regular non-reparse file, same identity and size exactly one byte before and after the failed read, and size strictly below every private marker encoding's minimum byte length: record a length-exclusion proof rather than a generic skip. Any missing stat/changed identity/size, other file path, DB/log/text or unexpected error fails the scanner.
proposed_scanner_change.minimum_marker: PRIVATE has 7 UTF-8 bytes and 14 UTF-16 bytes; a proven 1-byte file cannot contain any whole configured marker. Compute this bound from actual encoded markers, do not hardcode suffix assumptions.
proposed_scanner_change.all_other_files: Read every byte and scan all configured encodings; exclude only positively verified synthetic Git input config as before.
proposed_scanner_change.sql: Continue the complete read-only live SQLite scan of all tables, independently of file-lock length proof.
proposed_scanner_change.post_exit: Verify retained lock bytes and size again after fixture shutdown; preserve prior failed and inconclusive cuts separately.

decision: Maintain existing D25 FAIL/partial. A future specifically instrumented focal can establish the exact denied file and narrow one-byte proof; this read-only investigation does not rerun or retroactively turn the original runner green.
